author: Vertyco
description: Bot Arena 3 for ActivityHub, ported from the Flash game on Armor Games. Run a career with the original's parts, shop and 15 arenas, and try its 7 challenges. Careers follow players across every server and save themselves. Watch any battle in the server, or fight other players' teams 1 vs 1 with a global leaderboard. Uses the original's art, sounds and music. Arena prizes are in-game cash only, so Red credits are never touched. Needs ActivityHub 0.10.0 or later.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each player's Discord user ID, their Bot Arena 3 career (cash, level, robots and parts) and their PvP wins, losses, draws and Discord name for the global leaderboard.
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Bot Arena 3!

Bot Arena 3 is a game for ActivityHub, which must be installed and set up first:
`[p]repo add vrt-cogs https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs`
`[p]cog install vrt-cogs activityhub`
`[p]load activityhub`
Then follow ActivityHub's README: https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs/blob/main/activityhub/README.md

Once both are loaded, Bot Arena 3 shows up in the hub's menu.
short: Build robot teams and fight through 15 arenas, an ActivityHub port of the Flash game Bot Arena 3
